concept.name: Cafe Moulin
concept.tagline: Breakfast and crepes in Shadyside, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Sweet Crepe
menu.description: Thin French crepe folded with butter and sugar, or your choice of a simple sweet filling.
menu.imagePrompt: A folded crepe with butter and powdered sugar in a takeout clamshell box, overhead view, no text, no people.

menu.name: Ham and Cheese Crepe
menu.description: Savory buckwheat crepe filled with sliced ham and melted Swiss cheese.
menu.imagePrompt: A savory folded crepe filled with ham and melted cheese in a takeout container, overhead view, no text, no people.

menu.name: Spinach and Feta Crepe
menu.description: Savory crepe with sauteed spinach, feta, and herbs.
menu.imagePrompt: A savory folded crepe with spinach and crumbled feta in a takeout box, overhead view, no text, no people.

menu.name: Breakfast Crepe Combo
menu.description: Savory crepe with scrambled egg, cheese, and bacon, served with a side of fresh fruit.
menu.imagePrompt: A savory crepe with egg, cheese, and bacon beside a small cup of fresh fruit in takeout packaging, no text, no people.

menu.name: Egg Sandwich on Baguette
menu.description: Fried egg, cheese, and your choice of meat on a toasted baguette.
menu.imagePrompt: A toasted baguette egg sandwich cut in half in a paper wrap, no text, no people.

menu.name: Yogurt Parfait
menu.description: Greek yogurt layered with granola and seasonal fruit.
menu.imagePrompt: A clear cup of yogurt parfait with granola and berries with a lid, no text, no people.

menu.name: Drip Coffee
menu.description: Freshly brewed house coffee in a takeout cup.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout cup of coffee with a sleeve and lid on a counter, no text, no people.

brand.logoPrompt: A simple flat two-color mark of a folded crepe beside a steaming coffee cup, with the name Moulin set in a clean serif.
brand.voice: Warm and unfussy, like a neighborhood cafe that is glad you stopped in for a quick, good breakfast.
